‍What is the job? 

RDX Works is looking for a People Manager with real experience to help guide us to grow and develop from a small startup to a successful scale up!

The People manager will lead all aspects of HR including policy development, employee relations, compensation and benefits, working closely with the company management and our Talent Manager to develop a people-centric organisation. 

If you are not afraid to get stuck-in and prefer to iterate on approach on processes rather than suffering from “perfection paralysis”, then you might just be the one for us! In addition to all of this, you will not just be an order taker; we need someone who can generate ideas to solve novel needs and have an experimental approach and be open to taking risks! 


What are we looking for? 

  • You will provide day-to-day operational HR support to managers and employees
  • You will help develop and monitor overall HR policies, processes and procedures for a growing team based in the UK and internationally
  • You will help us build out the current company handbook as the go-to-resource for all team members
  • You will help us develop our onboarding and offboarding program for new hires helping to integrate remote team members into the team 
  • Working closely with the Talent Manager, you will help carve out and define the RDX culture 
  • You will oversee and manage our performance review process that drives high performance
  • You will promote and encourage personal and professional development, including through the use of the RDX education budget
  • You will continuously work to develop and improve HR policies and processes to enhance effectiveness and efficiency
  • You will work closely with finance and wider operations to maintain our pay plan and benefits program


What do you need?

  • Solid proven working experience as a People Manager within a scaling organisation - ideally a start up
  • Experience working in a fast growing organisation and knowledge around this 
  • Demonstrable experience developing company internal policies 
  • In-depth knowledge of labour law and HR best practices
  • Experience working with remote global teams

Nice to haves: 

  • CIPD Qualification 

Who are we? 

At RDX Works, we're a team of like-minded thinkers who have long been convinced that we're living in the earliest stages of a global financial revolution. This revolution is being fuelled by decentralized finance (or DeFi for short), which is enabling an assortment of pioneering developers and entrepreneurs to re-invent almost every financial product that is currently traded and invested in traditional markets, without requiring central authorities or siloed infrastructure. DeFi has captured a great deal of attention and investment in the crypto-aware niche, growing assets under management from $1 billion to $40 billion in less than a year. Impressive as its growth has been, its current market size isn't even a rounding error on the over $111 trillion held in traditional finance. We're focused on what it will take to go from billions to trillions.

RDX went back to first principles to come up with the right technical solution—the first layer-one protocol built specifically for mainstream DeFi—and we have already tested out at over 1 million transactions per second. We're keenly aware that the need for an infinitely scalable platform is only one prerequisite among many for mass adoption, and we're also blazing new ground in the areas of purpose-built developer tools, user experiences, and regulatory integration.

We have forged a path deep into the future of what distributed ledger technology is going to look like and we need you to come and be part of the team that is making that happen right now.

If this job sounds like it was made for you, then please apply here or email farrah@rdx.works for more information.
